reviews.feedback: internal/webhooks/webhooks.go, publicAddr (about line 116): an IP literal that carries an IPv6 zone (e.g. https://[fe80::1%25eth0]/, host fe80::1%eth0) is judged public. netip.Prefix.Contains returns false for zoned addresses, so the link-local prefix never matches. Strip the zone before the range check (e.g. ip = ip.Unmap().WithZone("")), and add a refused case such as "https://[fe80::1%25eth0]/" to TestCheckURL. The same fix covers the delivery-time check, since send uses checkHost.
